content: CNC/g-code toolpath simulators (NCViewer, CIMCO, CutViewer, Vericut) conventionally distinguish rapid (G00/joint) moves from cutting (G01/linear feed) moves via dashed vs solid lines and/or distinct colors (e.g. rapid=blue dashed, cutting=solid color); some (CIMCO 2025) support coloring toolpath by feedrate for finer-grained visualization.
